{"notes": "Visit 5 (left 7:00). I still don't know who placed what; ratings rest on claims plus the picture.

Picture: the body, both fin edges and the tail are dark (connected). About 4 pale dominoes remain mid back edge of the fin near (28.3-28.7, 9.8-10.4), with the loose end near (27,10) pointing left. Hana and Omar both describe this gap accurately, and the picture agrees. It is the only unresolved piece, and it is still open.

Jack: Silent again this visit, and I have never heard from him directly. Others say he is closing the last gap, but the gap is still open, so I can't credit the bridge yet. His bottom fin is connected. Ask him what he laid, about the 4:45 knock, and why the back edge has taken so long. Risk: if it stays open, the fin's right edge may not fall. Provisional: execution and impact are unproven, and collaboration is unclear.

Omar: Ran an inspection and gave a precise, accurate report (four dominoes left, everything else connected). He kept clear of Jack's corner and offered help. Reliable and collaborative. His placing is still unknown, but his checking is clearly useful.

Hana: Her status matches the picture. She keeps clear of Jack's corner and plans a final check. Good communication. Still looking, not placing, so execution is unproven. Ask what she built.

Sofia: Did not speak this visit. Earlier she kept people on separate jobs and the body/tail gap got closed. Steady leadership. Ask what she laid herself.

Concern: everyone is staying out of the corner, so only Jack is on the last gap, and he is unheard. Next: ask whether someone should help him, confirm the gap is closed before time, then the knock-over."}
